notes: The official careers page server-renders 154 Ashby job cards grouped by department and exposes two client-side menus, All locations (21 options) and All departments (20 options), inside #open-positions. Selecting either filters the already-rendered cards and issues no request, so there are no native query parameters. There is no keyword job search: the only search input on the page is the language selector (aria-label 'Search languages'). The Ashby board API is used by the adapter only for the complete unfiltered membership.
evidence: https://www.notion.com/careers (listboxes 'Filter jobs by location' with 21 options and 'Filter jobs by department' with 20 options; 154 cards)
https://api.ashbyhq.com/posting-api/job-board/notion?includeCompensation=true (unfiltered board used for membership; no filter parameters)
